title: 工程｜03 短剧启动与播放（待接入）

list.name: browser_selector
list.label: 浏览器流选择器（接入时核验）

options.content:
**待 TEST Cloud 接入验证；不是线上验收完成。** 本机已核验固定版本 Faro → Alloy → Loki 的日志字段。Cloud 托管浏览器入口需再核对实际流标签/格式，browser_selector 不得凭空猜测。无数据不等于0次失败。按同环境、版本、入口、网络/平台层比较，成功P50/P95与终态样本量一起看；低样本只观察，不自动排名或作人员考核。默认24h/5min，避免高频长窗查询。

开始/终态按窗口计数，**不是逐请求闭环或全访问覆盖**（无身份关联，窗口边界和丢报可影响结果）。先观察24–48h基线，再审核预算；后台、离页和主动停止单列。

启动成功必须first_frame+playing；canplay/地址返回不算。卡顿只用启动后前台非暂停/seek的waiting→playing；stalled只作网络诊断。没有播放总时长/会话分母，不叫卡顿率或完整播放质量覆盖。各分段有重叠，不可相加。

panels.title: 已知启动终态成功率
panels.description: 自动播放被拦是启动未达成，不是供应商错误；switched/left/background单列。

targets.expr: (sum (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_drama_terminal" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_drama_terminal" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | event_data_stage="startup" | event_data_outcome="playing" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_drama_terminal" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_drama_terminal" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | event_data_stage="startup" | event_data_outcome=~"playing|error|unplayable|autoplay_blocked" [$__range]))

sum by (event_data_playback_mode,event_data_outcome) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_drama_terminal" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_drama_terminal" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | event_data_stage="startup" [$__range]))

panels.title: 入口→真正开始播放 P50/P95

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_drama_startup" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_drama_startup" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="playing" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_playback_mode)

quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_drama_startup" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_drama_startup" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="playing" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_playback_mode)

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_drama_first_frame" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_drama_first_frame" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="playing" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_first_frame_method)

quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_drama_first_frame" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_drama_first_frame" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="playing" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_first_frame_method)

quantile_over_time(0.5, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_drama_catalog" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_drama_catalog" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="ready" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route)

quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_drama_catalog" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_drama_catalog" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="ready" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route)

panels.title: 播放中断的恢复/非恢复样本（非会话比例）

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_outcome) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_drama_stall" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_drama_stall" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | event_data_stage="rebuffer" | event_data_outcome!="waiting" [$__range]))

sum by (event_data_stage) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_drama_terminal" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_drama_terminal" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="$measurement_version" [$__range]))
